title: Allocation for the Centre of Excellence in AI for Education
summary: In the Union Budget 2025-26 the Finance Minister announced a Centre of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence for Education with an allocation of ₹500 crore. A Ministry of Education reply in the Lok Sabha on 20 July 2026, as reported by The Policy Edge, states that the centre has been set up at IIT Madras with ₹500 crore for the period 2025-26 to 2029-30. The centre is meant to develop AI tools for teaching and learning in line with the National Education Policy 2020.
purpose: Funding for a national Centre of Excellence developing AI tools for education.
